title: Pay the driver
why: Take 2 has the most life: Zhou's distrust of vague money drives the terms, and the closing read-back makes the job plain. The rules fix keeps that shape and no longer promises Vale is removed from the car.
changes: Beat 6, as the review directed: now "That'll do nicely. Leave the back seat to us." The decided Take happens inside the car, so the line no longer says Vale comes out [97f56ffa9d3e5a5394af33cc].

Beat 7, as the review directed: now "And I don't look round. Anyone watching this bay, I'll send off." Zhou no longer stands apart from a Take that ends with the car lent [97f56ffa9d3e5a5394af33cc][8fe3905df72fdcaf7a03f275].

Facts correction still open, as I can't edit the sheet here. Owner must replace "Getting Vale out of the back seat... Zhou doesn't want to see it" with: the Take happens inside the car, nothing to see, and it ends with the Enforcer at the wheel.

Build mismatch, not resolved here: built today, the Take ends with Vale still to be carried to the cell's car [8fe3905df72fdcaf7a03f275]. Both new lines stay true either way, but neither promises the lent car. All other beats, learned and opens are unchanged.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Not on the Councillor's bonnet. Last envelope said "nothing much", and lied.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: This one won't. We hear it's been a lean month.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: It has. What for? I drive the Councillor home at the chime.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not tonight. Take him round to the service bay, and wait.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: East yard. This buys a couple of minutes, then I drive on.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: That'll do nicely. Leave the back seat to us.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: And I don't look round. Anyone watching this bay, I'll send off.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: The envelope's yours, then. You haven't asked who we are.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Can't repeat what I don't know. Chime, service bay, couple of minutes.

learned: Zhou's paid: Vale's car waits briefly.
